title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity across Python/TS/Go and bump versions to v1.116.0
author: Aisha Patel
body: Summary: This PR unifies auth, retry, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and applies parity fixes identified during integration testing. It also bumps SDK package versions to v1.116.0 (Python), v1.116.0 (TS), and v0.116.0 (Go) to reflect the combined changes. Motivation: Over the last few quarters we've accumulated SDK divergences: inconsistent auth token refresh semantics, different default retry/backoff behaviors, and subtle streaming API surface differences (error handling, cancel semantics). These divergences cause customer confusion and make cross-language samples brittle. This change aims to present a consistent developer experience across languages and to close gaps found in the internal compatibility test matrix. Changes (high level): - Auth: centralize token refresh strategy and expose a consistent AuthProvider interface/constructor across SDKs; default behavior will be an automatic refresh with jittered backoff and an opt-out syncRefresh option for low-level use-cases. - Retries: align default retryable errors, max attempts, and exponential backoff cap. Add transparent retry hooks for observability. - Streaming APIs: normalize stream open/close/cancel semantics, ensure partial-message delivery is handled consistently, and standardize error codes and retry behavior on transient failures. - Ergonomics: update constructors and factory helpers for parity (Python: Client.from_config, TS: createClient(config), Go: NewClientWithConfig). - Tests & docs: add cross-SDK integration tests and update quickstart examples for parity. - Version bumps for all three SDKs and updated changelogs. Commits summary: - feat(sdk): unify auth provider interface across languages - fix(sdk/python): token refresh edge cases (race on shutdown) - feat(sdk/ts): streaming API cancel semantics + backpressure handling - feat(sdk/go): retry middleware and observability hooks - docs: update SDK quickstarts + changelog - test(integration): cross-language streaming parity tests Files changed (high level): - sdk/python/redwood/auth.py, sdk/python/redwood/client.py, sdk/python/setup.cfg - sdk/typescript/src/auth.ts, sdk/typescript/src/streaming.ts, sdk/typescript/package.json - sdk/go/auth.go, sdk/go/retries.go, sdk/go/client_factory.go - tests/integration/streaming_parity_test.go, tests/integration/streaming_parity_test.py, tests/integration/streaming_parity_test.ts - docs/sdk-changelog.md, examples/quickstarts/streaming-parity.md - ci/pipelines/sdk-e2e.yml Testing & CI: - Local unit tests updated for all SDKs. - Added integration smoke tests that run a short streaming scenario across all three SDKs (CI matrix). - CI: pipeline run initially failed on a flaky TS streaming test (race in close handler); fixed by ensuring drain before close. Final CI status: all checks pass on merge. Review notes and discussion (condensed): - Martin Zhao: "Can we avoid changing public type names in Go? That will break downstream users." Response (Aisha): "We kept public types stable; added thin constructors/view adapters to preserve main public types while exposing the new factory ergonomics. Documented the pattern in the changelog." - Priya Nair (request changes): "We need explicit opt-in for the aggressive retry policy for high-volume customers." Action: added config.retry_policy with explicit max_attempts and set conservative defaults; documented rollout plan. - Rafael Gomez: "TS streaming backpressure looks good, but ensure it doesn't increase memory for small clients." Response: "Added stream chunk size config with sensible default and validated memory usage in e2e smoke tests." Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main; changelogs updated and packages tagged. Rollout & migration notes: - Default behaviors are backward-compatible; conservative defaults and opt-out knobs provided. - Recommend internal platform teams to smoke-test the package upgrades in staging; no forced migrations required. Release notes: "SDKs: unified auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity across Python/TS/Go. Improved token refresh stability, standardized retry/backoff defaults, and consistent streaming error/cancel semantics. Bumped SDK versions to v1.116.0. See docs/sdk-changelog.md for details." Follow-ups/TODOs: - Monitor field error rates and stream telemetry for one week post-rollout (ENG-3245). - Add migration guide snippets for high-volume customers who want aggressive retry tuning.

release_notes: Unified SDK auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Improved token refresh reliability, standardized retry defaults, and consistent streaming semantics. Bumped SDK versions to v1.116.0. No breaking changes by default; opt-out/config knobs provided.
notes: This PR resolves parity inconsistencies uncovered by cross-SDK tests and is part of the ENG-3245 initiative to reduce developer friction across SDKs. Monitor streaming error telemetry and retry-related metrics after rollout.
